notes.title: Circle of Sumo is finally out!
notes.notes:
Hi, sumotoris!
Embrace your controller, adjust your belt,[b] Circle of Sumo[/b] is [b]out![/b]
Call your [b]friends[/b], your [b]relatives[/b] anyone who is at home with you and give them a gamepad, not the good one obv, and [b]have fun together![/b]
Like the good old days.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3oEduQETX7g6qLFLGM/giphy.gif[/img]

In Circle of Sumo, you have more than[b] twenty arenas[/b] and [b]eight sumotoris[/b] to choose from.
But that's not even all!
You can challenge your friends in one of the [b]extra games[/b], like soccer or ice skating!
Or you can even challenge your self in some [b]single-player mini-games[/b]!

Last but not least, we want to [b]thank[/b] every people who[b] wishlisted [/b]the game until now and believed in our work, well thanks for your [b]support[/b], hope you will like the game as much as we liked to develop it!

Don't forget to join our discord!
Have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36105907/c28cc475b5c9afb29558f10faaf5af7cd0f25546.gif[/img]

notes.title: Circle of Sumo is coming!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36105907/cdd950574505090bd7083132913da6477f31a6ab.gif[/img]

Hi Sumotoris!
[b]Circle of Sumo is finally coming on PC and MAC!
[/b]
We released the game on Switch some time ago, and from Friday 8th May will be out on Steam too!

You’re probably stuck at home, like all of us, and maybe you’re stuck with your relatives too.
Most of the time our family is the most precious thing we have, but sometimes you would like to kindly hit them with your belly and throw them as far away as possible from you.

[b]Well, Circle of Sumo is the game you are looking for!
[/b]
It's a local multiplayer game up to 4 players, where you can challenge your friends and relatives on more than twenty classic arenas choosing between eight different Sumo-wrestlers.
Afraid to be involved in a classic sumo fight?
No worries, we introduced some cool extra games: soccer, hockey, sumo hurdling, ice skating, and even two funny single players mini-games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36105907/7a5d34f83a4f4b0037eec430650be88a32994bc7.png[/img]
